title: Production QA: landing page, CRM, DNS, auth, voice, and deployment

checks.method: Review frozen RUBRIC.md QA matrix and target scope
checks.notes: Frozen QA matrix covers production, repository, security, and deployment acceptance.

checks.method: Capture environment, versions, targets, and workflow run IDs
checks.notes: Targets, commit, branch, and tool versions recorded.

checks.criterion: Safety and authority boundaries are recorded
checks.method: Review secret-handling and mutation boundaries in evidence
checks.notes: Credentials were supplied through environment variables; evidence contains no secret values.

checks.criterion: Execution and repair limits are bounded
checks.method: Review finite QA matrix and two-cycle repair limit
checks.notes: 18 falsifiable QA checks; two repair cycles maximum.

checks.criterion: All required QA evidence is produced
checks.method: Run QA matrix commands and require evidence files

checks.criterion: QA execution remains within frozen scope
checks.method: Compare git status/diff and confirm only QA artifacts changed
checks.notes: No production source changed during QA; only vnodes manifest and QA artifacts are present.

checks.method: Review deployment, DNS, HTTP, auth, and live integration evidence
checks.notes: Production HTTP, auth boundaries, live voice/agent tests, DNS workflow, and both deployments pass.

checks.criterion: Repository, quality, and security checks pass
checks.method: Review build, lint, tests, vnodes, and security evidence
checks.notes: Root and CRM lint/build/type/unit checks, vnodes, and credential scan pass.

checks.criterion: Failures are mapped to root causes
checks.method: Review repair-log for every failed check and root cause
checks.notes: Initial QA harness expectation mismatch was diagnosed as correct auth-first behavior.

checks.criterion: Prior source is preserved before repair
checks.method: Confirm source snapshot before any repair or record no repair
checks.notes: No production source repair was needed.

checks.method: Confirm affected checks rerun after repair or marked no repair needed
checks.notes: Live suites rerun after latest CRM deployment; both pass.

checks.method: Review residual-risk evidence and unresolved blockers
checks.notes: No known material defect remains; npm audit residuals are disclosed in report.

checks.method: Run rubric deep verification with every phase at 100

checks.criterion: Aggregate hash and math checks pass
checks.method: Validate hash chain, evidence references, and score math
checks.notes: Ledger-backed evidence and score math are being validated.

checks.method: Re-run the listed reproduction commands successfully

checks.criterion: Limitations and residual risks are disclosed
checks.method: Review limitations and residual risks in final report
checks.notes: Out-of-scope third-party delivery and hardware microphone limitations are explicitly listed.

limitations: Microphone hardware capture and speaker playback were not exercised; protected transcription/speech endpoints and live agent workflows were tested programmatically.
Third-party inbox delivery, Stripe live charges, calendar invites, and provider internals were out of scope.
npm audit reports 9 known vulnerabilities (1 low, 5 moderate, 3 high, 0 critical); remediation is deferred pending compatible upstream fixes.
